description: Last real conclusion of every job in every push/pull_request workflow. The object list is discovered by parsing .github/workflows, not enumerated here, because the enforcement surface ledger only classifies scripts/qa/* and would never have looked at boundary-coverage, test, clippy, miri or cross-compile. Verified offline by scripts/qa/ci-liveness.rb in the ci.yml governance job; refreshed from `gh run` locally with --refresh --write.

knownFailing.reason: Only the liveness step failed in run 30275254232. All 23 other gates in the job reported success — including bash32-lexer on its first CI execution and doc-lint, which had been red on the parent 7b97a338 — and every other job in the run was green, including both coverage-policy-fixtures legs. The cause is the recorded shape: this ledger described run 30206361027 at 6ffaf84d, and 91c8c973 then added the bash32-lexer step to ci.yml, so every record described a pipeline that no longer existed. This is the two-step convergence DD-146 records — the job cannot record its own recovery in one pass, because its liveness step runs inside itself. This refresh makes the record current against a run at 4a2bdd20, which is after that ci.yml change; the next run should show governance green and the following refresh drops this annotation.

workflows.reason: triggered by v* tags and workflow_dispatch only, so it has no last-run-on-main to assert. A release that fails is visible at the moment someone cuts it, and recording a stale tag build here would say less than nothing.
